fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.Q_D_integer_value: For every integer D≥2, any positive partial-menu allocation with main taking ≥2 g-items in one row forces ≥2 corresponding helpers to take the same unique A_a, impossible under disjointness. Main therefore gets at most one 1/D item. Main one g, that helper A_a, and every other helper its home g attains V=1/D. This is an integer allocation argument independent of fractional λ.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.complete_flat_integer_forward: Given any partial threshold v, put each selector on its chosen state, export only allocated positive incidences, and place every other original incidence, including all unselected states and all zero jobs, on its own private machine. Selected private load is 2−value≤2−v; unselected private load is 1; each resource gets at most one unit job. Every original job is arranged once.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.complete_flat_integer_reverse: From any complete flat actual schedule of peak C<2, each resource can contain at most one unit incidence. Each selector-selected state has original private mass 1, so its actually exported mass is at least 2−C; these exported bundles are disjoint across groups. Therefore V≥2−C. The C≥2 branch already gives C≥2−1/D. Hence complete ordinary-UM OPT(P_D)=2−V=2−1/D. No CONFIG certificate is being treated as an integer schedule.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.Q_D_CONFIG1: Same common FSLP λ: main each state 1/D; helper home g has 1−1/D and parking A_a has 1/D. Each g column sum 1/D+1−1/D=1; each A_a sum D/D=1. Q_D incidences have strictly positive private times 1/D or 1, so its private configurations are selector singleton at λ and all incidences at 1−λ; each incidence also receives resource singleton mass λ. Coverage is exactly 1. General zero-incidence case uses selector+all zero jobs at λ and all incidences including zeros at 1−λ; zero coverage λ+(1−λ)=1, private load unchanged, and no zero singleton capacity is needed on resources.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.v3_target_domain: Nonempty finite fully explicit menus; common d,h≥1; each complete state is a private full d-ary height-h tree; all internal machines private across states; unit selector; each job has parent time 1/d and a unique unit child/external endpoint; no additional jobs, preload, eligibility or alternative finite times. Actual μ is max complete-state leaf preimage multiplicity, not total resource multiplicity across states. A looser integer μ0 is also a legal upper bound.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.v3_T1_exact_step: Full target CONFIG(1) gives s=0 and a=d. Let r=ceil(d/(μ+2)). Since d≥(μ+2)(r−1)+1, b=d−μ(r−1)≥2r−1≥1 and μ(r−1)<d. For h≥1, (2r−1)^h+1≥2r^h, so b^h≥2r^h−1. With the same common λ and actual multiplicity capacities, rainbow-blocker/Haxell existence selects root-disjoint rainbow r-subtrees. Return to the original d-ary physical jobs: active internals carry incoming unit plus d−r small jobs, giving 2−r/d; every unselected or zero-λ state and every unused branch is fully parent-filled with load 1; each external gets at most one unit. Thus a complete target actual σ′ exists with C′≤2−r/d<2. The denominator remains original d, never auxiliary a.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.low_peak_decoder_direction: The only actual decoding direction used is target complete low-peak actual schedule -> source complete actual schedule with peak no larger. Apply it to σ′ to get 2−1/D=OPT(P_D)≤C′≤2−r/d. Rearrangement gives Dr≤d. Since r≥1, d≥D; since r≥d/(μ+2), μ≥D−2. No forward actual schedule map or full OPT equality is required.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.upper_bound_mu0: Use the v3 theorem with any integer upper bound μ0≥μ: necessarily D ceil(d/(μ0+2))≤d. D>μ0+2 gives contradiction. When D=μ0+2 the condition is equivalent to D|d, only necessary. A fixed d≤d0 excludes D>d0. Neither equality nor admissible parameter bounds construct a compiler or prove sufficiency.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.OPT_scalar_equivalence: In this target domain CONFIG1 ensures OPT(P′)<2, and both nonempty finite assignment sets attain their optima. The low-peak existence contract applied to a target minimizer implies OPT(P_D)≤OPT(P′). Conversely that scalar inequality lets every target low-peak schedule use the same source optimum schedule with peak≤its target peak. This is existence only; there is no algorithmic choice or unknown-OPT algorithm input.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.strict_domain_separation: Menu V=1/D and state-dummy/N/P_SC actual max-min value 1/D are maximization values; complete flat ordinary UM makespan is 2−1/D. SC highest finite CONFIG threshold 1 and flat machine CONFIG1 feasibility are different certificates in their own models. They are connected only by the stated norm1/full-job or dummy/path bridges, with path forward old-value/threshold≤1. The decoder obstruction uses the original complete flat ordinary UM, never the SC row/degree-three image as a v3 target. N binary-selector/port structure has its own unit selectors, times and sharing and cannot be identified with global d=2 private-tree structure.
fresh_mathematical_reconstruction.lambda_no_loadbearing_misconnection: The λ calculation proves fractional CONFIG1 only. The exact 1/D integer menu value is separately proved by resource disjointness; the exact 2−1/D UM value uses a separate full-job integer two-way mapping. The comparison to v3 uses an independently obtained actual σ′. No fractional-to-integer shortcut, LP value-as-OPT step, or SC/UM objective identification was found.
